# Kayan Training & Consulting

Kayan is an Omani consulting and training firm building operational excellence,
lean management, and continuous improvement capabilities across organizations in
Oman and the wider GCC region.

## Main sections

- Events: https://kayan.om/en/events — conferences and one-off training events.
- Training Courses: https://kayan.om/en/training-courses — recurring professional
  training programs.
- Blog: https://kayan.om/en/blog — articles on operational excellence, lean, and
  continuous improvement.
- Contact: https://kayan.om/en/contact-us

Arabic versions of every page are available at the equivalent /ar/ path.
